dedupe_keys.name: university of edinburgh optenergy power network data gb iceland european and test networks

description: The OptEnergy network data page of the University of Edinburgh School of Mathematics offers power flow test cases built from real transmission networks for research on optimal power flow. The page read on 2026-09-26, last updated 31 March 2013, lists a 39-bus New England case with realistic cost data, a 118-bus Iceland transmission network with 35 generators, reduced and revised reduced Great Britain networks of 29 buses and 66 generators, a complete GB transmission network of 2,224 buses, 3,207 branches and 394 generators, and an anonymised European network of 21,097 buses, 32,112 branches and 2,769 generators, plus a dynamic data set for Iceland. Coverage is therefore Great Britain, Iceland and continental Europe. The case files are free to download from the page, which states neither their format nor a licence; planned scripts such as a PSAT to MATPOWER filter are marked as not yet available. Caveats: the data are more than ten years old and do not reflect today's networks, the European case is anonymised, and some entries (an Irish network) have missing statistics. Simulation uses are testing optimal power flow and network flow algorithms on large realistic transmission systems. Related records: data-pglib-opf gathers optimal power flow benchmarks, and model-matpower is the tool such case files are commonly run in.
